sentences.text:
on 13 September,
2024
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.25472 of 2024
Order:

This writ petition is filed to declare the seizure of stock of 75 quintals (150 bags) of rice under cover of panchanama dated 08.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.114 of 2024 of Munagala Police Station, Suryapet District filed under Section 420 of Indian Penal Code and Section 7 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (for short 'the E.C. Act'), as arbitrary and illegal.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Civil Supplies appearing on behalf of respondent Nos.1 to 4 and learned Government Pleader for Home appearing on behalf of respondent No.5 perused the entire material on record.
3.

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that in similar circumstances this Court disposed of the W.P.No.16664 of 2024 on 03.07.2024 and directed SK,J the respondents therein to release the seized stock of rice in favour of the petitioners therein with some conditions and requested to pass similar order.
4. The learned Assistant Government Pleader for respondents has not disputed the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and requested to pass appropriate order.

5. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsels on the both sides, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents to release the seized stock of 75 quintals (150 bags) of rice in favour of the petitioner on a condition of furnishing immovable property as a security equivalent to the value thereof, if the stocks have not been disposed of by way of interim sale so far.
Release of stock shall be subject to outcome of the confiscation proceedings under Section 6-A of the Act, 1955.
6. Accordingly, with the above directions, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
The miscellaneous petitions pending, if any shall stand closed.
M/S. O.S. Traders vs The State Of Telangana.
